item.tib: pho nya mgyogs lam gyis nye mkho yang gab snying gi me long
item.coloph: pho nya mgyogs pa'i gsang lam 'di mtha' bsdud du/ yang gab snying gi me long zab mo 'di/ bstan 'gror phan par 'os tshe mchog tu bsngags/ rang 'dod chags pa'i dbang song dam la 'gal/ nyon mongs rang kha ma yi srog gshed shog dam ldan rnam 'byor pho mo'i bde lam gyur//
